metadata.title: Uchi no 3 Shimai
metadata.synopsis: The daily life of the Motsumoto family. The three sisters, Fuu, Suu, and Chii, follow what happens on a daily basis. Mother and Father have to deal with them sometimes, but they're used to it.
metadata.background: Based off the author's 2005 blog of the same name. Adapts stories from the blog, and features original segments.
